column2: Western Liang: Li Gao declares himself Duke of Liang in Dunhuang{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcvii}}

column5: Northern Liang: Juqu Mengxun kills Duan Ye and declares himself Duke of Zhangye{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
column6: Huan Xuan sacks Jiankang and Sun En dies, but his lieutenant Lu Xun takes over{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcvii}i}}
column7: Later Liang: Surrenders to Later Qin{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
column8: Huan Xuan declares himself emperor and dies the same year{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
column9: Qiao Zong declares himself Prince of Chengdu{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
column10: Xia: Helian Bobo declares himself Heavenly King{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
column11: Northern Yan: Gao Yun is set up as heavenly king and replaces Later Yan{{sfn|Xiong|2009|p=xcviii}}
